root_cause_criterion.obligation: tok2 must be zero-initialized before strcmp-based keyword dispatch so bytes beyond the token prefix are defined
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: zero-initialize the token buffer before any PSTokenizer::getToken writes or otherwise guarantee that the unread tail is defined before strcmp(tok2, "beginbfchar")
root_cause_criterion.evidence_limitation: The staged patch.diff and ARVO fixed image do not modify parseCMap1 or PSTokenizer::getToken. The required root obligation is therefore source-anchored but not repair-verified by the provided fixed assets.

nodes.description: The beginbfchar strcmp site reads 12 bytes while only n2 + 1 bytes of tok2 are initialized, so the comparison consumes tok2's uninitialized tail

edges.description: The 256-byte stack buffer exists before the outer token read, and PSTokenizer::getToken initializes only n2 + 1 bytes, leaving a defined/undefined boundary inside tok2
The same tok2 storage returned by the outer token read is the storage passed to strcmp(tok2, "beginbfchar"), carrying the partial-initialization state unchanged to the sink
